# Private consumer result

Owned Java 8 private instance helper consumes its sole Object formal through a complete binary callback and returns a fixed private static member class of the same owner. Public code calls the helper on an independently supplied peer, so receiver state and returned identity remain observable independently of the caller and callback result.

Frozen callers cover four routes, 20 modes twice, callback and nested result casts at their original positions, nulls, partial snapshots, distinct/aliased receivers and receiver mutation. Source and SDK-input profiles compare definitions and full metadata/Exceptions and compile all emitted Java. Signature-only and independent wrong-program controls do not change the observer.
